title: Services in NPC conversations
summary: Asking an NPC about services now tells you straight away whether they can help, and lists every service they run.
items: Services shows why a service can't be used right now, for example the shop is closed, the NPC or your character isn't there, or the DM hasn't switched it on.
An NPC who runs more than one service shows a short numbered list to pick from; Never mind goes back.
People & NPCs now shows the conversation for an NPC who offers services, even if they don't barter.
Blacksmith commissions work exactly as before.
